_about: 撒豆成兵 — the crowd run, a 塔防-family level type, a prototype (Hanli 10-20: 「对, 做一个撒豆成兵的关卡」; the genre: crowd + math gates, Count Masters / Mob Control; the art bar: 《向僵尸开炮》). 小满 scatters beans that become a squad of bean soldiers; they charge up the 山道 through 符门 gates (+ × good, − ÷ traps), past hazards and bean pickups, crash into the 兽潮 hordes (crowds cancel out) and end at 合窳. Drag left/right (A/D, ←/→ on Mac) steers. The engine: scripts/games/sadou/core.js (pure, headless, bots); the play: scripts/games/sadou/sadou.min.mjs (Phaser, built from tools/sadou/). Distances (`at`, `len`) are px along the road at `speed` px/s; lateral `x` is −1 (the road's left edge) … 1 (its right).

beasts._about: power: how many soldiers one beast is worth in a clash. size: the drawn height px. frames: 守墙关's painted frames, shared (scripts/games/shouqiang/art/<id>-<frame>.webp); `run` alternates the walk frames, `hit` flashes on a loss.

title.en: Beans into Soldiers · the Mountain Road

lead.zh: 蒙山的山道上，兽潮压下来了。
lead.en: Down Mount Meng's road, the beast tide is coming.

lead.zh: 小满抓出一把黄豆，往山道上一撒——
lead.en: Xiaoman grabs a fistful of beans and flings them down the road —

levels._track: In road order. gates: [left, right] (null = no gate on that side); op + − x /. beans: a line of beans at x, +n if the crowd runs over it. hazard: kind spikes|log over x [a, b] for `len` px, `kill` = the share of the soldiers over it lost while crossing; `swing`/`period` sway a log side to side. horde: [[beast, n], …] across the whole road (`span` narrows it), the first kind the back line.

moments._about: 银月's lines at the level's moments (the defaults; at start the host may send her prefetched ones — doc/game-kit.md § 台词预取). One is picked per moment.

start.zh: 豆子落地，兵就起来了。往前冲！
start.en: Beans hit the ground, soldiers stand up. Charge!

good.en: A good gate! More of us.

bad.en: Oops, that gate was a trap.

low.en: We're thin. Find a gate that adds!

won.zh: 合窳倒了！豆兵们，好样的。
won.en: The Heyu is down. Well done, bean soldiers.

lost.en: Out of beans… one more handful.
